about: Statutory limits applied on top of the outcome model (src/decisionintake/guards.py, DECISIONS D32). Each rule was checked against PolicyEngine-US results on the training households: kept only if at most 2% of the households it matches get the programme (survey-weighted).

rules.why: For one adult with no children, the EITC is zero once earnings reach $19,540 (2026).
rules.source: 26 U.S.C. 32 and 24(d); PolicyEngine-US 2.152.15 parameters gov.irs.credits (tax year 2026)

rules.why: For one adult with no children and no earnings, there is no EITC (it needs earned income) and no refundable child tax credit (it needs earnings above $2,500).
rules.source: 26 U.S.C. 32 and 24(d); PolicyEngine-US 2.152.15 parameters gov.irs.credits (tax year 2026)
